prompt:
Use case identity-preserve, transparent game key-pose sprite sheet. INPUT1 approved 이루어질 idle SD is the immutable anatomy AND style master. INPUT2 grid-layout ONLY. Draw ONLY 이루어질, the same person in every cell. Tablet retained in left hand; deliberate precise pointing thrusts with right hand, sharply controlled geometric blue prediction marks.
Redraw ONLY poses, never enlarge the skull, face or eyes or shorten limbs compared with INPUT1. Preserve head/shoulder ratio, head/torso ratio, neck, humerus, forearm, thigh, calf, boots and hands. Same black outline, flat cel planes and costume landmarks. Shallow orthographic 3/4 facing RIGHT, no foreshortening.
EXACT TWO columns TWO rows, four equal portrait cells, transparent background, invisible grid. Request native 3072x4096. Each figure stays within middle 70% of its cell, leave 15% padding around the entire hair, boots, weapons and hands. Upright-equivalent height 70% cell height; SAME drawing scale across all cells. Crouching and leaning lowers the crown, NEVER enlarge pose to fill its cell. Put lowest grounded boot at 85% cell height, centered pelvis at 50% cell width. Do NOT draw grid or labels.
Row-major cells:
1: forward running stride, torso leaned toward right, one leading foot near ground, coat trailing left
2: firm forward interception pose, braced front leg, tool or forearm raised to meet an incoming strike from the right
3: stagger backward toward left, torso recoiling, bent knees, equipment retained, pained but alive
4: confident forward follow-through, stable stance, tool or fist directed right, not a victory dance

Exactly two anatomically connected arms/hands, correctly directed thumbs; retain equipment handedness and shape from idle. Never use huge hair/skull/eyes to exaggerate reactions. No scenery, floor, shadows, glow, effects, gore, detached limbs or extra people. Anatomical proportions IDENTICAL to approved reference; existing older motion sheets are NOT references.
